part.text:
Fixed. The bug was in `CookieFilter.Filter` (modules/logging/filters.go:459): request headers are logged as `LoggableStringArray`, so the filter encoder passes the cookie header values via the field's `Interface`, but the filter only read `in.String` (empty for arrays) and wrote the result back to `in.String`, which was then dropped — leaving cookies unfiltered.

The fix (matching upstream caddy #4943):
- Read the cookie lines from `in.Interface.(caddyhttp.LoggableStringArray)` (returning the field unchanged otherwise)
- Write the filtered cookies back as `in.Interface = LoggableStringArray(transformedRequest.Header["Cookie"])`

Verified in the container: `go test ./modules/logging/ ./modules/caddyhttp/ ./caddyconfig/httpcaddyfile/` all pass, including the previously failing `TestCookieFilter`. (Note: the container had no access to proxy.golang.org; tests were run with `GOPROXY=https://goproxy.cn,direct`.)
